I woke up to a grey, overcast morning, the kind that tends to linger and dampen spirits. As I made my way to the kitchen, I noticed a piece of paper taped to the cabinet, reminding me to check the expiration dates on the food in the pantry. It was a simple, everyday task, but it sparked a moment of clarity. 

I realized how often we overlook the small, mundane routines that can be surprisingly beneficial. Checking expiration dates on food, decluttering a space, responding to emails in a timely manner - these are the little things that add up to a more organized and efficient life.
